urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Public web pages to capture. Duplicates are skipped.

viewport.title: Device
viewport.description: Desktop, tablet or mobile size, or Custom to set your own width and height. Mobile pages are rendered with a phone user agent and touch support.

width.title: Custom width (px)
width.description: Used only when Device is Custom.

height.title: Custom height (px)
height.description: Used only when Device is Custom.

format.title: Image format
format.description: PNG by default. JPEG and WebP files are smaller.

quality.title: Image quality
quality.description: JPEG and WebP only, 1 to 100. Default 85.

pdfFormat.title: PDF paper size
pdfFormat.description: A4 by default. The PDF always contains the whole page.

waitStrategy.title: Wait until
waitStrategy.description: When to take the shot: after the page load event (default), when the network goes quiet, after a fixed delay, or when a CSS selector appears.

waitDelaySeconds.title: Fixed delay (seconds)
waitDelaySeconds.description: Used with the fixed delay option. Default 2 seconds.

waitSelector.title: Wait for CSS selector
waitSelector.description: Used with the selector option, for example "#main" or ".price".

elementSelector.title: Capture one element
elementSelector.description: Optional CSS selector. The image then shows only the first visible matching element.

css.title: Custom CSS
css.description: Optional CSS injected before capture, for example to hide a chat widget. Up to 20,000 characters.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout per page (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: How long one page may take, including loading and capture. Default 60.

maxConcurrency.title: Pages at the same time
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages are captured in parallel. Default 2.

fullPage.title: Full-page screenshot
fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of only the visible window.

pdf.title: Also save a PDF
pdf.description: Save a PDF of each page next to the image.

printBackground.title: Include backgrounds in the PDF
printBackground.description: Keep background colours and images in the PDF.

hideCookieBanners.title: Hide cookie banners
hideCookieBanners.description: Hide common cookie and consent pop-ups before capture. Nothing is accepted on your behalf.

blockAds.title: Block ads
blockAds.description: Block common ad and tracking scripts for a cleaner, faster capture.

darkMode.title: Dark mode
darkMode.description: Ask the site for its dark colour scheme, if it has one.

scrollPage.title: Load lazy images
scrollPage.description: Scroll through the page first so images that load on scroll are included.
